## Today's Focus: The Nervous System of Modern Organisations

> "If hardware and software are the engines and machines of our digital world, then data management is the fuel and telecommunications and networking are the roads and highways that connect everything together."

Three interconnected areas:

1. **Data and information management** — turning raw data into actionable insights
2. **Telecommunications and networking** — the pathways connecting all infrastructure components
3. **Internet and wireless technologies** — how modern connectivity enables new business models and ways of working

---

## Why These Areas Matter

| Element | Analogy | Without it… |
|---|---|---|
| Hardware & Software | Engines and machines | — |
| Data management | Fuel | Even the most powerful infrastructure becomes useless |
| Telecommunications & networking | Roads and highways | Isolated systems cannot create value from connection and collaboration |

---

## Three Learning Objectives

1. **Data and information management** — Understand how organisations turn raw data into valuable business insights; all hardware/software infrastructure ultimately exists to process, store, and analyse data.

2. **Telecommunications and networking** — Examine the pathways connecting infrastructure components; even the best infrastructure needs robust networks to deliver value.

3. **Internet and wireless technologies** — Investigate how modern connectivity supports business operations and enables entirely new business models.
